visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a black and blue handheld blower branded KIKITO in a first-person perspective. The blower's rear intake and a circular digital display are clearly visible, showing various status icons. In the background, a dark grey car is parked on a wet, foamy concrete floor. The lighting is bright and artificial, typical of a car wash facility at night. (2) The person moves the blower toward a white and grey Volkswagen van. As the nozzle gets closer to the side mirror and window, water droplets are visibly blown off the surface. The person's hand is steady, gripping the ergonomic handle of the device while the digital display glows with blue light. (3) A high-speed time-lapse sequence begins, indicated by a '8X 快轉' overlay and a clock in the upper left corner. The creator moves rapidly around the van, directing the high-velocity air stream at the roof, windows, side panels, and wheels. Water is seen spraying and evaporating from the car's body. The timer counts up from 0:00 to 8:12, representing the real-time duration of the drying process. The background remains consistent, showing a covered wash bay area with wet ground. (4) The drying process concludes, and the person holds the blower up again to show the battery status in a close-up shot. Two red light bars on the battery pack indicate that approximately half of the power remains. The person toggles the device toward the camera before the shot ends. The van in the background appears significantly drier than at the start of the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a driving synthesized drum beat starts immediately. A sharp mechanical click sound marks the activation of the device, followed by an intense, high-pitched burst of broadband wind noise that dominates the audio spectrum. The BGM tempo is roughly 124 BPM. (2) The continuous, loud whooshing of the high-velocity air blower becomes the primary acoustic layer. The texture of the wind noise fluctuates slightly in spectral brightness as the nozzle moves across different surfaces of the car. The BGM remains steady in the background, providing a consistent rhythmic foundation. No vocal presence is detected. (3) The wind noise ceases abruptly following a mechanical click of the power switch. The BGM continues briefly at full volume before a hard cut ends the audio track. The ambient room tone of the covered shed is barely audible in the final seconds.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demonstrate the practical efficiency and battery endurance of a high-power portable blower (KIKITO) by documenting the entire process of drying a large van in real-time, then revealing that only half the battery was consumed.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand logo 'KIKITO' is clearly visible on the product, and the entire video functions as a practical performance demonstration of the device.
